_sobre: Quem fala cada trecho das frases com fala de personagem (texto no formato do campo `fala` de docs/narracao/frases-dom-quixote-parte-3-en.json, sem mudar palavras). Frases fora daqui são da NARRADORA. Elenco em ../elenco.json.
p1-s8: cheered Sancho, hopping up and down.
p1-s10: Anyone who writes with so much feeling has a noble heart,
said the knight, with a sigh.
p1-s11: Books keep the most beautiful secrets of the heart!
p2-s1: Looking at those mountains, so big and so quiet, Don Quixote had an idea:
Friend Sancho, I shall stay here in this clearing to show the world my great longing for Dulcinea, and how much I miss her, just like amadis of Gaul, the hero of my books!
p2-s2: And you will ride your donkey and take a love letter right into her hands.
p2-s3: how can I tell Lady Dulcinea that you nearly went bonkers from missing her, if I don’t see anything bonkers with my own eyes?
p3-s4: He scratched his forehead and tried to remember the words he had kept only in his memory:
p3-s8: How did he sign it again?
p4-s3: He’ll never want to go home,
unless a young lady in danger asks his sword for help!
p4-s4: said the priest, his eyes shining.
p4-s5: Let’s make up a princess in danger!
p5-s4: O brave knight, flower of all knights!
she begged in a sweet voice.
p5-s5: I am princess micomicona, from the faraway kingdom of Micomicón!
p5-s6: A wicked giant, Pandafilando of the Gloomy Glare, has taken over my lands, and only you can save my people!
p5-s7: Deeply touched, Don Quixote held out his hand to the young woman and made a promise:
p5-s8: I swear by my sword that I shall beat that giant!
p6-s1: Back at the inn, everyone was sleeping peacefully when battle cries woke up the whole house:
p6-s9: Calm down, my good man, I’ll pay for everything!
p7-s3: Then Don Quixote stood up at the end of the table and gave a wise and beautiful speech about the arms of knights, their swords and shields, and the letters of books:
The courage of knights keeps the peace and protects those who are weaker.
p7-s4: And books, my friends, make justice, truth and beauty grow in our hearts!
